name: Camp Winnebago
description_short: A classic Maine sleepaway camp for boys ages 8 to 15 that has stayed small on purpose, with athletics, activities and wilderness trips.

warnings: Camp type 'sleepaway' is inferred from multi-week full-summer sessions and the '7-Week Advantage' menu item; the page does not say outright that campers stay overnight.

There are two addresses and phone numbers: 19 Echo Lake Rd, Fayette, ME (207-685-4918) from June 1 to Labor Day, and 131 Ocean St, South Portland, ME 04106 (207-767-1019) from Labor Day to June 1. The camp address is listed; the header phone is the off-season office.
unknowns: Whether the camp is for boys, girls, or both

changes: Added gender_policy boys and ages 8 to 15 from the Welcome page ('a classic Maine summer sleepaway camp for boys... Boys ages 8-15').
camp_type sleepaway is now stated outright on the Welcome page, so the old inference warning no longer applies.
